svg.text: GenAI / ML Standardization Workshop — Technical Architecture
Labs 1–5 mapped onto the AI lifecycle · Amazon SageMaker AI · all infrastructure provisioned by scripts/deploy-workshop.sh

g.text: • VPC: 2 private subnets + public + NAT GW
• IAM execution roles: product / userA / userB
• S3 Access Grants — governed data access
read governed S3 data via Access Grants
Governed platform: domain, roles, buckets, catalog
• Enforce for synthetic, advise for Dolly
• 2D EMR on EC2 — managed Spark clusters
• Dataset design · validation before GPU spend
• Prompt as a versioned, lineage-tracked input
• Time travel: FOR VERSION AS OF snapshot
JSONL + template.json in S3 · Iceberg baselines
• Metrics are only valid relative to a prompt
Approved status is the control point
• SQS_QUEUE_URL env var on the endpoint
turns on inference capture for Lab 5
• Deployment is a pipeline, not a notebook
baseline pinned FOR VERSION AS OF
• Operational vs statistical vs audit signals
INFERENCE CAPTURE DATA PLANE — templates/4-inference-capture.yaml (real infrastructure, not notebook code)
Athena / Glue Iceberg · inference_responses · monitoring_responses · ground_truth_updates
DLQ on the queue · 5-data-prep.yaml holds the drift baselines
SHARED PLATFORM FOUNDATION — provisioned once in Lab 1, consumed by every later lab
IAM execution roles · S3 Access Grants
Glue Data Catalog · Athena · S3 Table Buckets
SageMaker managed MLflow: experiments · model registry · prompt registry
INFRASTRUCTURE AS CODE — scripts/deploy-workshop.sh deploys six independent CloudFormation stacks in dependency order
templates staged in S3 · outputs threaded forward as parameters

svg.text: Solid arrows = artifact hand-off between labs · dashed orange = monitoring feedback loop · dashed box = opt-in component. Lab 2B–2E are alternatives; 2F always follows. templates/main.yaml is deprecated.
